contributions.claim: Al Jazeera headline attributes to WHO detection in the Netherlands of a twelfth hantavirus-infected person; WHO chief urges all countries to monitor cruise passengers.
contributions.attribution: WHO and Tedros via Al Jazeera
contributions.uncertainty: Sparse excerpt does not name ship, person, or define count population; likely the crew case but not demonstrably a separate infected person.

relations.reason: Same date, disease and country are compatible with the crew case, but identity is absent.

delta_expectations.reason: New attributed cumulative count and monitoring advice are material; counting an additional thirteenth person is unsupported.

ambiguity_notes: Publication-order simulation: authentic availability unknown. Do not equate a new publisher report with an additional case or resolve unnamed-ship identity conclusively.
